question: Will the Lebanon 45-day ceasefire extension (announced May 15) formally collapse — defined as US withdrawal of sponsorship OR Lebanese government publicly declaring the truce void — before EOD 2026-05-22?
delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO. By EOD 2026-05-22 no party formally terminated: US sponsorship stayed intact, the Lebanese government issued a 23 May statement presupposing the truce extant, and the 15 May 45-day extension remained operative with a 29 May security track scheduled. The truce was de facto shredded (continued IDF strikes, ~6 medics killed around 22 May) but the literal criterion requires formal US/Lebanese withdrawal, which did not occur. AMBIGUOUS caveat logged: a naive read of the casualty record would call YES; the formal-collapse criterion forces NO. Recommend tightening the criterion for future Lebanon forecasts.
resolution_criteria: YES if US State Dept or Lebanese FM publicly declares the ceasefire void/withdrawn; OR IDF+Hezbollah resume sustained exchange at pre-April-16 intensity (>50 launches/day each) and both US and Lebanon acknowledge breakdown. Individual violations do NOT resolve YES.
resolution_source_rule: US State Dept press release/named spokesperson; OR Lebanese govt official in Reuters/AP/AFP; OR combined IDF/LBAF situation reports at pre-truce intensity.
ambiguity_rule: IDF strikes outside Beirut governorate = NOT collapse. Hezbollah verbal threat without acting = NOT collapse. Collapse requires formal withdrawal of US or Lebanese support.

question: Will Netanyahu formally announce an early election date earlier than the mandatory 2026-10-27 date before EOD 2026-06-01?
delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO. By EOD 2026-06-01 Netanyahu made no formal announcement of an election date earlier than 27 Oct. On the OR clause: the dissolution bill's preliminary (110-0, 20 May) and first reading (106-0, 2 Jun) do NOT satisfy 'passes a formal dissolution motion by majority vote,' which requires FINAL (third-reading) passage; the House Committee postponed setting any date. First reading is not final passage and no date was set, so NO resolves clean.
resolution_criteria: YES if Netanyahu makes a formal Knesset speech or public announcement naming an election date earlier than 2026-10-27; OR if the Knesset passes a formal dissolution motion by majority vote. Leaks/speculation do NOT resolve.
resolution_source_rule: Times of Israel, Haaretz, or Channel 12/13 citing direct Netanyahu statement or official Knesset vote record. Reuters/AP for international.
ambiguity_rule: Coalition partner threatening dissolution without formal Knesset vote = NOT resolved. Netanyahu 'considering' per aides = NOT resolved. Only a formal announcement by Netanyahu himself or a passed (final-reading) dissolution vote counts.
